# on the positive side (the free-wheeling use) the diode is reverse biased whenever the circuit is at rest or driven and the open path is what the solver should see; in series (a decoupling use)
# the solver sees an open circuit where the diode would conduct. Request elec-21 asks the core for a one-way path; the contact row comes with its answer (spec.md Notes).
